card.name: The word greater in thresholds
card.fires_on: The word "greater" (often capitalized) starting a "greater than" cutoff in dosing tables, lab limits and weight bands. It also fires weakly on a few unrelated word starts like "radical" and "br-ack-ish".

modes.label: Greater than cutoff
modes.description: "Greater" opens a "greater than" limit for weight, lab value or count.

modes.label: Lab value comparison
modes.description: "greater" follows a lab name or open bracket before "than" and a number.
